"""Read supplied SLX ZIP XML as source data only; never load/execute a model."""
from pathlib import Path
import datetime,hashlib,io,json,re,traceback,zipfile,xml.etree.ElementTree as ET
HERE=Path(__file__).resolve().parent
T=HERE.parent
SOURCE=T/'REFERENCE_SPR_BALANCED_INFANTRY_MATLAB_SOURCE_REVIEW_20261030_V1/inputs/matlab.zip'
SELECT=['matlab/LQR_Control_with_VMC.slx','matlab/my_control.slx','matlab/my_control_bad.slx','matlab/my_text.slx']

def put(path,obj):
    with path.open('x',encoding='utf-8') as f:json.dump(obj,f,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2)

def main():
    assert not (HERE/'CONSUMED_BEFORE_SOURCE_READ.json').exists()
    put(HERE/'CONSUMED_BEFORE_SOURCE_READ.json',dict(
        purpose='mod4.SPR_supplied_SLX_readonly_XML_structure_for_own_teacher_v2',
        utc=datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat(),
        selected_members=SELECT,archive_new_source_read_once=True,
        no_MATLAB_SDK_model_execution_dependencies_callback_or_foreign_robot_adoption=True))
    rows=[]
    try:
        b=SOURCE.read_bytes();sha=hashlib.sha256(b).hexdigest()
        assert len(b)==2396673 and sha=='3d4c189ed7f78ddc073c9e47e44876ed9c169fa52b1abffb87b0325d8f4d357a'
        with zipfile.ZipFile(io.BytesIO(b)) as outer:
            for member in SELECT:
                info=outer.getinfo(member);assert info.file_size<2_000_000
                slx=outer.read(member)
                d=HERE/'complete_source_XML'/Path(member).stem;d.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
                row=dict(member=member,bytes=len(slx),SHA=hashlib.sha256(slx).hexdigest(),
